'''J'Ruush''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]], minion of [[Szajin]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], serving as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team.<ref name="To Pierce the Heavens" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
J'Ruush is featured in the expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was the first Whipdid to appear in the series.<ref name="To Pierce the Heavens" />
